issues.problem: tathā is rendered 'वैसे ही'; the Sanskrit has no eva here, so ही is added (glossary: add nothing the line lacks).
āgatam agrees with bhayam, the object of vīkṣya, so it is accusative, not nominative.
tāvat ... yāvat is a correlative pair; the first member 'so long' is not rendered.
Labelled bahuvrīhi; it is a tat-puruṣa (arisen from one womb, ablative relation), with eka-udara inside.
Labelled bahuvrīhi; it is a tat-puruṣa (born in/under one star, locative relation).
'लोग' (people) is added; the verse has no such noun (the notes admit this, and the English avoids it).
